# MM-P3-L3-SB01 Maintenance manual - Machining shot blast cabinet #1
Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01

Scope
- This document provides maintenance instructions for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) for routine inspection, wear part replacement, and media top-up. Refer to MM-P3-L3-SB01-S2, SB-1022, and SOP-P3-L3-03 for related procedures and drawings.

Tools
- Torque wrench capable of achieving 105 N·m.
- Standard hand tools, flashlight, and PPE as specified in SOP-P3-L3-03.
- Replacement blast wheel liner as per SB-1022.

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out EQ-P3-L3-SB01 in accordance with SOP-P3-L3-03 before any maintenance.
- Remove access panels and inspect blast wheel liner for wear and foreign debris. Clean area and verify no loose fragments remain.
- When replacing the blast wheel liner, install liner and fasteners finger-tight, then set final bolt torque to 105 N·m using the torque wrench. Verify each bolt meets the specified torque.
- Check shot media level and top up to manufacturer-recommended level following guidance in SB-1022. The shot media top-up interval for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is 22 hours; record top-up events in the maintenance log.
- Reinstall access panels, remove lockout, and perform functional check per SOP-P3-L3-03. Confirm no abnormal vibration or noise before returning to service.

Acceptance criteria
- Blast wheel liner fasteners are torqued to 105 N·m and secure with no visible gaps or misalignment.
- No loose liner fragments or foreign debris present in the cabinet or discharge paths.
- Shot media replenished according to the 22 hours top-up interval and recorded in the maintenance log.
- Post-maintenance functional check yields normal operation with no abnormal vibration, noise, or material flow issues per SOP-P3-L3-03.
- All work documented and cross-referenced to MM-P3-L3-SB01-S2 and SB-1022 for parts and installation verification.
